description: This file contains utility methods for handling C# identifiers, including checking if an identifier is a C# keyword and sanitizing identifiers to valid C# syntax.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: A static utility class for processing C# identifiers to verify keywords and sanitize input strings into valid identifier names.

methods.name: IsCSharpKeyword
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a reserved C# keyword.

methods.name: SanitizeIdentifierName
methods.description: Sanitizes an input string to be a valid C# identifier by prefixing leading digits with '_' and removing invalid characters.
